Verdict: needs_changes.

FINDING (high, correctness): Setup/doctor `exact_command` values are not validated against the repo’s command validator. Evidence: `validate_command_tokens` rejects `dontpanic doctor --agent`, `dontpanic doctor --project myrepo`, `dontpanic reconcile homes --dry-run`, `dontpanic agent brief`, and `dontpanic projects add ... --onboard --force --yes`, while `what-now`/dashboard now emit them as exact commands. Recommendation: update `command_validation.py` for the F005/F006/F007 command surface and add tests that every emitted setup `exact_command` validates.

FINDING (medium, test_coverage): The new F012 tests assert command strings but do not exercise the exact-command validator, which is why the invalid shapes above slipped through. Evidence: `test_setup_state_reachable_*` checks `choice.exact_command == command`, but never calls `validate_command_tokens`. Recommendation: extend the parametrized setup cases to validate every non-null exact command.
